body: Angular is following [semver](http://semver.org/), and the jump from 2 to 4 is major. Major version changes denote that incompatible API changes were made. By upgrading from 2 to 4 you actually *should* expect breaking changes.
@vicb I think this behavior is caused by inheritance of `Injectable()` decorators at AoT compilation. could you check this out?

My reason to have this in the first place is the documentation for dependency injection (https://angular.io/docs/ts/latest/cookbook/dependency-injection.html#!#-injectable-):
```
We add @Injectable() from the start for the sake of consistency and to avoid future pain.
```

So having the `@Injectable()` on `AlarmService` is explictly encouraged in Angular.
as for me it's a valid bug
I am going to change the compiler for v4 to only emit a warning, so we don't break users / users are able to create components that work in v2 and v4.

1) we need to find its declaration place, to be able to compare across
re-export s
2) for summaries, we need to read the metadata of all angular decorators
eagerly, so that dependents don't need to reevaluate them
